releaseRule: Only indicators marked approved may be included in a public build.

world-bank.licence: CC BY 4.0 unless indicator metadata states otherwise
requirements: Name the World Bank, dataset, indicator, observation year and access date
Preserve the original provider shown in indicator metadata
Do not imply endorsement or use the World Bank logo
Exclude indicators carrying incompatible third-party restrictions
Preserve source metadata and observation year
Verify the licence on each dataset
Do not use the OECD logo or imply endorsement
